title: RepoAssure Packed MCP Server Installation and Protocol Validation v0.1
objective: Create a local tarball, install it into an isolated consumer, start the installed node_modules/.bin/hardening-mcp entrypoint without source-workspace node_modules, and validate the real MCP initialize, tools/list, and bounded read-only tools/call protocol sequence while proving clean shutdown, redaction, protocol framing, and no target repository writes.
acceptance: Use TDD: begin with a failing integration or protocol contract that installs the local package tarball in an isolated consumer and invokes its installed hardening-mcp bin.
Validate the MCP initialize handshake, tools/list response for the existing registry, and one bounded read-only tools/call response over stdio.
Assert protocol framing, schema compatibility, redaction, deterministic process shutdown, source-workspace independence, and no target repository writes.
Do not add or rename MCP tools, productize repair MCP commands, publish npm, deploy, or change runtime detector or acceptance behavior.
Cascade the result through operations, testing, acceptance, canonical docs, logs, and Autopilot state, then run full repository gates.
